IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Hudgins, Hasegawa, and Roberts)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring coverage for lead blood level assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to lead blood level assessments; adding a newsection to chapter 74.09 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall provide coverage for lead blood levelassessments under this chapter for any eligible children younger thantwentyone years old in accordance with early and periodic screeningand diagnostic treatment services as defined in section 1905 of TitleXIX of the federal social security act and its implementing regulationsand guidelines.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2008, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
